migrate2newaccount.py.summary: Re-publish every local repository under a new GitHub account.
details: For each repository below the current directory it stages and commits the pending changes, creates ``<NEW_USER>/<repo>`` as a private repository with ``gh repo create``, rewrites ``origin`` to the SSH URL of the new owner and pushes all branches and tags.

migrate_git_user.py.summary: Switch the local git identity to a new user name, e-mail and SSH key.
details: Updates ``~/.gitconfig``, removes the old SSH keys, generates a new ed25519 key, writes ``~/.ssh/config`` and the agent setup, then rewrites the old identity in git configuration files, repository remotes and source files across the home directory.
migrate_git_user.py.notes: Highly destructive: it regenerates SSH keys and rewrites git remotes; edit the identity constants first.

mkart.py.summary: Interactive text-art generator for English and Arabic text.
details: Reads text lines from the terminal, detects whether the script is Arabic or Latin and renders the characters as block art (large glyph maps for both scripts). ``clear`` clears the screen and ``quit``/``exit`` stops the loop.

mkdebs.py.summary: Repackage installed apt packages as ``.deb`` files.
details: Uses python-apt to list the installed packages and their file lists, rebuilds a ``control`` file and a ``data.tar.xz`` from the files on disk and assembles a real ``.deb`` with ``unix_ar`` under ``~/debs``.

mkhtml.py.summary: Write a small HTML page skeleton to a file.
details: Saves a template that links ``style.css`` and ``script.js`` and contains a heading placeholder; the target defaults to ``index.html``.

mkinit.py.summary: Generate or refresh ``__init__.py`` files that re-export a package's public names.
details: Parses each module of the package, collects the public functions, classes and constants (honouring an existing ``__all__``), writes the ``from .module import name`` block within the line limit and skips private or excluded names. ``--recursive`` descends into sub-packages, ``--check``/``--dry-run`` only report.

mkinit2.py.summary: Rebuild the ``__init__.py`` of a package from its modules' public names.
details: Collects the public definitions per module in a process pool, merges them with the declarations already present in ``__init__.py`` and writes a new file that imports everything (backing up the previous version).

mkpic.py.summary: Compile Python files to bytecode, optionally deleting the sources.
details: Runs ``compileall`` over the files or directories given (default: every ``.py`` below the current directory, in a worker pool) with the chosen ``--optimize`` level; ``--legacy`` writes the ``.pyc`` next to the source instead of ``__pycache__`` and ``REMOVE_ORIG`` deletes the ``.py`` afterwards.

mkpyc.py.summary: Compile Python files to ``__pycache__`` bytecode in parallel.
details: Compiles every ``.py`` file given on the command line (or below the current directory) with ``compileall`` using a small spawn-based worker pool and reports how the tree size changed.

Detects the build backend (setuptools, poetry, flit, hatchling ...), reads the PEP 621 metadata (with TOML fallbacks), discovers packages and package data and writes a ``setup.py`` that reproduces that metadata for tools that still need one.

mkx.py.summary: Make scripts and binaries below the current directory executable.
details: Adds the execute bits to the files that need them: scripts with a shebang, files in ``bin``/``sbin``/``.bin`` folders and shared objects, using a worker pool for the chmod calls.

mosaic.py.summary: Build a photo mosaic from a folder of tile images.
details: Loads and resizes the tiles, matches each grid cell of the target image to the tile with the closest average colour and blends the tile layer with the target (``OVERLAY_STRENGTH``) before saving the mosaic. The paths, grid size, tile size and blend strength are module constants.
mosaic.py.notes: Configure ``FOLDER_OF_IMAGES``, ``IMAGE_TO_MAKE`` and the grid constants before running.

move_tests_dirs.py.summary: Move the ``tests`` folders of the installed packages into ``~/tmp/tests_dirs``.
details: Scans the Termux ``site-packages`` (skipping numpy, pandas, scipy and numba) for ``tests``/``test`` directories, moves each one to the destination with its package prefix and reports the results; ``-d`` only lists what would move.

mvl.py.summary: Move a range of lines from one file to the end of another.
details: Appends lines ``start`` through ``end`` (one-based, inclusive) to the destination file and removes them from the source, both edited in place.
